entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's for a helmet.
Got it, I see the order right here. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference thing. The color on the website looked like a bright red, but in person, it's more of a muted burgundy. It's not what I was hoping for.
I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be a bit different. Is the item still in its original packaging?
Yes, the box is unopened. I saw the color through the plastic window on the side and decided it wasn't for me.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. Since you received it just seven days ago, you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for gear. We can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied, especially with something as crucial for safety as a helmet.

That's good to hear. Now, since the color on the website was a bit misleading and I have to go through the trouble of shipping it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? To offset the inconvenience.

I appreciate you asking, and I understand your position. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns, I can assure you the return process is straightforward. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You just need to print it out and attach it to the original box.
So the return shipping is free then?

The label is for your convenience so you don't have to pay out of pocket at the post office. The standard return shipping fee will be deducted from your total refund amount, as outlined in our policy. But you will get the full price of the item back.
Alright, I suppose that's fair. As long as I can get most of my money back. I'll just find another helmet on the site.

Excellent. The email with the label and instructions has been sent. Once our warehouse receives the unopened box, we'll process your refund within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
